observations.behavior: Adds a new anomaly taxonomy and detection policy for Duckgres usage pulls, including recoverable and non-recoverable anomaly classifications, exception definitions, and a detection function.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks if the Duckgres watermark cursor is ahead of the last recorded ack, potentially indicating lost billable usage; this could prevent permanent under-billing by withholding the ack until the issue is resolved.

observations.behavior: Adds a detection function and its unit tests, including a matrix of all anomaly conditions and their expected recoverability and exception types.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides test coverage for the anomaly detection and recovery policy, including edge cases like no recorded watermark and benign behind scenarios, which could help prevent false positives and ensure reliable billing and data integrity.
